texts.name: Subheading
texts.text: To stabilize, optimize, and modernize the platform, our approach focused on key infrastructure, deployment, and development improvements.

texts.name: MEV partnered with Source Digital to deliver a production-ready Clever SSO integration for an educational platform initiative under a fixed deadline, while keeping the existing username and password flow intact. Alongside the SSO rollout, Source Digital also wanted to reduce long-term dependency risk in its SDK ecosystem.
texts.text: OpenStudy was an Atlanta-based educational social network built around real-time, peer-to-peer study support in a Q&A format. Middle and high school students could ask questions, help one another, and study subjects including algebra, biology, physics, mathematics, and world history. The next stage of product development required a more reliable platform, mobile access, and a monetization model that could reward active users without disrupting the experience the community already valued.

texts.name: We implemented Clever OAuth 2.0 end-to-end across backend and frontend, including identity mapping, token handling, and integration with the existing AWS Cognito setup. The scope also covered automated provisioning and roster synchronization, including initial import and incremental updates, plus conflict handling for mismatched data.
texts.text: The broader product combined real-time interaction with game mechanics, analytics, and skills assessment. Its assessment engines could provide users with credentials for job and internship applications.

texts.text: OpenStudy had more than 2 million users. By the time Brainly acquired the company, OpenStudy reported that its Q&A platform had helped 54 million learners.

texts.name: Subheading
texts.text: OpenStudy’s platform had become unstable under growing data volumes. The company needed to maintain and evolve the Scala backend, build a mobile product, and introduce monetization.

texts.name: MEV partnered with Source Digital to deliver a production-ready Clever SSO integration for an educational platform initiative under a fixed deadline, while keeping the existing username and password flow intact. Alongside the SSO rollout, Source Digital also wanted to reduce long-term dependency risk in its SDK ecosystem.
texts.text:
Over four months, a MEV team stabilized the platform and updated its infrastructure. MEV then designed and developed a native mobile app, aligned its interface and navigation with the existing web experience, and rolled out a virtual economy in stages to recognize and reward high-performing users.

The optimized platform handled approximately four times more requests per minute at peak load. OpenStudy expanded access through mobile, added a revenue stream, and increased engagement through faster performance and easier access.
